'''2004 Oregon State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 19 June 2004 at the Willow Springs Apt Community Center, 3240 SW Doyle Place, Beaverton, Oregon.<ref name="pcf-3383-46989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46989#46989 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210617/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47102%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Glenn Hall]] directed it with [[Uriah Watkins]].<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" /><ref name="pcf-3383-47783">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47783#47783 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Thirteen players took part.<ref name="pcf-3383-47783" /> [[Edward Fones]] won: he was second after the six-game Swiss with a 4–1 record and then won both games of the final confrontation against [[Noah Franke|Noah Frank]].<ref name="pcf-3383-47778">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47778#47778 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Willow Springs Apt Community Center, 3240 SW Doyle Place, Beaverton, Oregon<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" />
* '''Dates:''' 19 June 2004, 10 AM<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" />
* '''Tournament directors:''' [[Glenn Hall]], [[Uriah Watkins]]<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" /><ref name="pcf-3383-47783" />
* '''Structure:''' sanctioned, six games with a final confrontation; completed Light Side and Dark Side decklists required by 10 AM<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" />
* '''Players:''' 13<ref name="pcf-3383-47783" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Edward Fones]]<ref name="pcf-3383-47778" />

All players were to receive consolation prizes, including uncut sheets, packs and tournament foils.<ref name="pcf-3383-46989" />

Fones arrived after the first game had started; he began the second game with no points, so the missed game counted as a loss.<ref name="pcf-3383-47783" /><ref name="pcf-3383-47869">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47869#47869 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
